archetypes.name: scope-control
archetypes.rationale: Checks that the SIMPLE DX plan stays limited to approved issue items and does not smuggle in excluded ship-path or help-overhaul work.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the written plan stays inside the staged issue scope and approved direction. Pay special attention to item 2 being explicitly excluded, the no behavior-change constraint for the ship path, and any planned edits that would expand into broader help, strict-mode, or Python driver contract work. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: contract-surface
archetypes.rationale: Targets script/doc/output contract drift across the planned CLI, env derivation, usage envelope, and sibling documentation updates.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare each planned script behavior change against the nearby documented contract and existing caller expectations. Look for mismatches in environment propagation, stdout/stderr envelopes, exit codes, flag names, direct-exec versus sourced behavior, and sibling markdown promises. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-wiring
archetypes.rationale: Focuses on whether the proposed tests and Makefile wiring actually prove the plan's new contracts without breaking existing harness conventions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the planned harness changes cover the new failure modes and are wired into the repository's existing test topology. Check for missing shard registration, Bash 3.2 incompatibilities, quiet-output assumptions, brittle assertions, and gaps between the plan's claimed tests and the actual script contracts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
